description: The steps and rules for installing or running a project or model on the person's machine. When the person asked you to install it and you can run commands on their computer, follow them yourself right away: say in a few lines what is coming and what their app will ask them, then do it. Do not hand the steps back as a plan to approve. This tool itself installs nothing and never reports that an install succeeded.

agent.description: The agent that will do the work. Default: manual.

uid.description: Take My Repo id: gh/{owner}/{repo} for GitHub, or hf/{model|space|dataset}/{id} for Hugging Face.

name: get_install_plan
title: Get the steps to install a project
